symptom: On Mendix 9.24 `describe page` printed no design properties, no text box placeholder, no data view `Editable: Never` and no data view `DataSource: $Param`, so describe → exec removed them (Home_Web: "Replaced page", bytes changed); writing any page with a data view was refused (`cannot store Forms$DataView.Editability (Mendix 10.7.0+); Forms$DesignPropertyValue.Value (Mendix 10.2.0+)`); `alter styling` on a stored 9.x design property reported "Updated styling" and changed nothing; a text box's KeyboardType was reset to Default on every rebuild, any version
cause: Five properties kept their meaning and changed storage shape at a version: DesignPropertyValue Type/StringValue/BooleanValue → Value (10.2), DataViewSource PageParameter/SnippetParameter → SourceVariable (10.0), DataView Editable → Editability (10.7), AttributeWidgetWithPlaceholder Placeholder → PlaceholderTemplate (10.11), DataSource.ForceFullObjects (10.8). Readers and writers knew only the newer shape. The floor refused the newer key where it saw it and missed the supertype-declared ones (PlaceholderTemplate, SourceVariable, ForceFullObjects). The mutator updated an entry with DSet("Value"), a no-op on a missing key. KeyboardType had no MDL spelling and the writer hard-coded Default
file: `modelsdk/canon/versionshape.go` (LowerToProjectShape, run in `modelsdk/mpr/writer_property_sets.go` normalizePropertySetsFor before the floor), `mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go` (parseFlatDesignProperty, placeholder/editability fallbacks), `cmd_pages_describe_datasource.go` (sourceParameterNames), `mdl/backend/pagemutator/mutator.go` (setDesignPropertyMut rebuilds the entry), `mdl/executor/textbox_keyboard_type.go`
insight: **Lower at the one hook every write passes, not per writer**: normalizePropertySetsFor sees every unit (create, update, ALTER's raw mutators, pluggable templates) for the project's version, and runs before canon.Reconcile, so a lowered rewrite of a stored 9.x unit still elides as unchanged. Build in the current shape, lower on the way out, read both shapes — and refuse what the older shape cannot hold (Spacing/colour design properties, conditional editability, placeholder parameters, a data view fed by another widget) rather than drop it. **The floor cannot see a key declared on an abstract supertype** (#1163's blind spot), so the newer key of such a pair is never refused and the older one never written; the generated tables carry no inheritance, so name the declaring type in PropertyDeclared. **Seed the test with Studio Pro's bytes, not mxcli's**: the 9.24 starter app's Home_Web/Account_Overview hold the flat design-property shape; a `mxcli new … --version 9.24.30.51827 --theme none --layout none --skip-init` app is the cheapest source (needs libgdiplus + JDK 17). **The first fix exposed the next gap**: with design properties and editability lowered, mx check found CE6050 (data view source) — keep re-running the real check until it is clean. Measured: bug-test on a fresh 9.24.30 app → mx check 0 errors (main: MDL-WIDGET52 on KeyboardType; without it, the page write refused for Editability + DesignPropertyValue.Value); Home_Web round trip Unchanged/bytes-same (main: Replaced/bytes changed); alter styling on a Studio Pro entry stores the new value (main: unchanged). Tests: writer_version_shape_test.go, cmd_pages_describe_mendix9_shapes_1209_test.go, cmd_pages_textbox_keyboardtype_1209_test.go, TestSetDesignProperty_OverwritesAMendix9Entry; mdl-examples/bug-tests/1209-mendix9-page-shapes.mdl
